description: Command AI aircraft as your wing. Recruit or buy wingmen, fly ten reactive formation shapes, coordinate targets, and issue orders - rejoin, engage on a tether, attack, fall back, orbit, deliver cargo, land. Wingmen now defend themselves against missile warnings with seeker-aware countermeasures and resume their queued order. Includes radial, MFD and tactical-map controls plus HUD/map symbology. EARLY DEVELOPMENT: not balanced, host or single-player only, and expect behaviour and config to change between versions.
